jobs.title: Applied AI Security Architect
jobs.reason: This is a senior pre-sales technical security architect role requiring 7+ years of enterprise security/cloud architecture experience and deep technical knowledge of network security, IAM, encryption, and compliance frameworks (GDPR, EU AI Act, DORA, NIS2). Hard ineligibility triggered on both seniority (7+ years required) and specialist technical skills the candidate cannot substitute for. Field alignment is weak — this is enterprise sales engineering, not AI policy/governance research.

jobs.title: Strategic Litigation Team Manager
jobs.reason: Human rights litigation aligns with the candidate's interests in international law and justice, but this is a Manager-level role within Reprieve's pay structure (Project/Regional Leads/Managers band) requiring significant prior experience and likely legal qualifications for strategic litigation work. Hard ineligibility on seniority.
jobs.salary: £52,088 plus up to 5% employee matched pension contribution

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Cyber APAC
jobs.reason: This is a cybersecurity sales/account management role focused on revenue targets, cold-calling, and CRM pipeline management — pure commercial sales rather than intelligence, research, or policy work. It also hard-requires a minimum of 5 years' experience, triggering ineligibility on seniority.

jobs.title: Coordinator - Responsible Sourcing
jobs.reason: This is an operational/administrative coordination role focused on scheduling, invoicing, and client service logistics for ESG audits — not a research or analytical role on responsible sourcing or human rights. While the ESG/modern slavery context has tangential relevance, the actual work is administrative coordination far from the candidate's research and policy targets.

jobs.title: Consulting Associate- Contaminated Land and Remediation (Entry Level)
jobs.reason: This is an environmental sciences/geology fieldwork role requiring soil sampling, groundwater monitoring, and a relevant environmental/geoscience degree plus a UK driving licence — none of which align with the candidate's IR/policy background. Entry-level seniority fits, but the field and technical skills mismatch is fundamental.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Mechatronics Engineering
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a Mechatronics Engineering lectureship requiring an MSc in engineering and eligibility for Professional Engineer registration in South Africa, none of which the candidate has. Hard ineligibility on specialist qualifications.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Officer (MSF IE)
jobs.reason: Digital marketing/fundraising for a humanitarian NGO sits outside the candidate's policy-research, intelligence, and OSINT target zones — it's an operational marketing role, not a research or analyst position. The role requires specialist skills the candidate lacks (PPC, SEO, CRM, CMS, e-commerce platforms, Canva/Adobe content production) and demands 3–5 years of digital marketing experience, which the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Lead Analyst, Technology and Geopolitics
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — Sibylline is a core target firm and the tech/geopolitics intersection fits the candidate's interests. However, the "Lead Analyst" title combined with expectations of defining an intellectual agenda, thought leadership, and demonstrable prior engagement with technological risk topics points to a senior hire with several years of relevant analyst experience, which the candidate (still completing MSc) does not have.

jobs.title: Change Delivery Lead
jobs.reason: This is a senior change/programme management role requiring PRINCE2/MSP/PMI-type qualifications, LEAN/Six Sigma experience, and a track record of leading organisation-wide transformation — none of which the candidate possesses. The salary band and "senior role for an experienced change leader" framing confirm this is well beyond entry level, triggering hard ineligibility on seniority. Field alignment is also weak: this is internal business-process change, not humanitarian policy or research.

jobs.title: Staff+ Software Engineer, Developer Productivity
jobs.reason: This is a senior software engineering role requiring 15+ years of experience building large-scale developer infrastructure, deep expertise in build systems, CI/CD, and languages like Rust/Go — none of which align with the candidate's IR research profile. Hard ineligibility on seniority (Staff+ level, 15+ years experience).

jobs.title: Head of AI & Business Intelligence - London
jobs.reason: "Head of" role requires substantial senior leadership experience in AI/BI that the candidate (MSc student with student-assistant roles) does not have — hard ineligibility on seniority. The role is also a technical/data leadership position rather than policy research, so field alignment is weak.

jobs.title: Lecturer in African Music
jobs.reason: This is a music/ethnomusicology lectureship requiring a completed PhD in Music or related field (Anthropology/Area Studies) with a specialism in African music — a hard ineligibility trigger as the candidate is an MSc student with no PhD and no background in music studies. Field, skills, and seniority all mismatch fundamentally.
jobs.type: Full-time, Fixed Term Contract (1 Sept 2026 – 1 July 2029)

jobs.title: Lecturer in Photography
jobs.reason: This is a Lecturer post in photography practice requiring professional photography expertise and teaching experience in a creative arts discipline — entirely outside the candidate's IR/policy field. The role also requires academic teaching seniority the candidate does not have.

jobs.title: Administrative Volunteer (Casework Team)
jobs.reason: INQUEST works on state accountability for deaths in custody, which is adjacent to the candidate's human rights and international law interests but not a core target area. The role is administrative volunteering rather than research, so it doesn't leverage the candidate's analytical or writing strengths, and unpaid volunteer work is a weak fit for someone seeking research roles.

jobs.title: Lecturer in Intelligence Studies
jobs.reason: Field alignment is excellent — intelligence studies at KCL War Studies is core to the candidate's security/IR interests. However, this is a permanent academic Lecturer post requiring a completed PhD, an established publication record, PhD supervision capacity, and the ability to secure external research funding. Hard ineligibility on seniority (PhD requirement and academic faculty level).
jobs.salary: £45,031 to £52,514 per annum including London Weighting Allowance

jobs.title: Lead Auditor (Aerospace)
jobs.reason: This is an aerospace management systems auditor role requiring substantial aviation/defence industry auditing experience and sector-specific regulatory expertise — none of which the candidate has. The "Lead" title and specialist auditor qualifications place it firmly outside the candidate's profile.

jobs.title: Lead Project Manager
jobs.reason: Complete mismatch — this is a senior engineering/EPC project management role in oil & gas infrastructure requiring an engineering degree, 10+ years of capital project delivery experience, and specialist knowledge of API/ASME/ISO codes. Hard ineligibility triggered on the 10+ years requirement and on the senior "Lead" title.
